'''''Limonium vulgare''''', called '''common sea-lavender''', is a species of flowering plant in the genus ''[[Limonium]]'' native to [[Atlantic]] parts of Europe from southwestern Sweden to southwestern [[Iberia]], and introduced elsewhere.<ref name="687035-1" >{{cite web |url=http://powo.science.kew.org/taxon/urn:lsid:ipni.org:names:687035-1 |title=''Limonium vulgare'' Mill. |author=<!--Not stated--> |date=2017 |website=Plants of the World Online |publisher=Board of Trustees of the Royal Botanic Gardens, Kew |access-date=1 November 2020 }}</ref><ref>{{cite web |title=7. L. vulgare |url=http://www.floraiberica.es/floraiberica/texto/pdfs/03_055_04_Limonium.pdf |publisher=[[Flora Iberica]] |access-date=16 September 2021 |page=19}}</ref> A clumping perennial found in [[salt marsh]]es and other maritime habitats, it is a probable [[species complex]] that includes ''[[Limonium maritimum]]'' and ''[[Limonium narbonense|L. narbonense]]''.<ref>{{cite journal |title=Genome sizes and phylogenetic relationships suggest recent divergence of closely related species of the ''Limonium vulgare'' complex (Plumbaginaceae) |year=2018 |last1=Róis |first1=Ana S. |last2=Castro |first2=Sílvia |last3=Loureiro |first3=João |last4=Sádio |first4=Flávio |last5=Rhazi |first5=Laila |last6=Guara-Requena |first6=Miguel |last7=Caperta |first7=Ana D. |journal=Plant Systematics and Evolution |volume=304 |issue=8 |pages=955–967 |doi=10.1007/s00606-018-1524-1 |bibcode=2018PSyEv.304..955R |s2cid=49484212 }}</ref>
